facts.fact: Central Bank of Libya Circular 6 of 2026 authorises exchange companies it has licensed to carry out direct foreign remittances for firms and small traders, up to USD 100,000 a transfer and USD 300,000 a year per firm, with banks executing the SWIFT transfer.

LBY.note: Commission caps only; no consumer-protection rule or complaints body stated.
Remittances via exchange companies and SWIFT are stated but no named corridor.
